theorems.name: Submission.ts_piece_projection_continuousOn_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ v ∈ C, ∀ w ∈ C, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F v - F w‖) → (∀ w ∈ C, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F w)) → ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) C → ∃ G : Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), ContinuousOn G (F '' C) ∧ ∀ w ∈ C, G (F w) = (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F w).toLinearMap).starProjection
